text:
I have been using PIDC for 3 years now from basic cleaning, cavaties, to replacing caps and my latest a tooth extraction with implant.
They are always fantastic with scheduling and the care during treatment is second to none.
To top it all off their pricing is fair and very affordable.
I have personally recommended them to several friends for any dental care you need in the Pattaya area.

I called and spoke with the English speaking receptionist, and I got an appointment about 7 days out. Walking in, I was very impressed with the office, professionally decorated and immaculate clean. Although in a busy area, it is very quiet inside. The treatment rooms are upstairs and are also very quiet. Dr. Korn speaks English very well and he did a thorough inspection of my mouth,  prior to cleaning. He used a rotary cleaner & descaler that got all the calculus off my teeth, followed  by a polishing. My teeth have never felt so smooth as they did after his treatment. The staff and the doctor are all very professional and the pricing is very reasonable. I felt like I was in Good hands and well taken care of.
- I would come here again for more treatments, I highly  recommend this clinic. They get High marks in professionalism and services provided.
Motorbike Parking on side street, or ride  cab, bhat bus. Car parking may be difficult.

Called for an appointment for 6 month clean and scale.

Arrived early, filled out new client paperwork left to grab a coffee and returned.

Dentist was running a little late (25 minutes), but no problem as I had time to spare.

Walked upstairs sat down, dentist gave my teeth a quick check then cleaned, scaled and fluoride finish in 30 minutes.

All staff spoke good English, very polite and professional.

I will use again when in Pattaya. Total cost 1,500 THB
